name: Company
observations: Owner: the repo owner (GitHub xadjibayev88). A one-person media operation run with AI agents and automation

Main product: an Uzbek-language YouTube Shorts channel, niche 'Bilarmidingiz — qiziqarli faktlar' (space, animals, the human body, history, the ocean, technology, nature, countries, food, ancient civilisations)

Shorts are made automatically by shorts-agent: Gemini writes a 45-75 word story (hook, tension, twist), Edge TTS voices it in Uzbek (Sardor or Madina), Pexels supplies vertical stock video, ffmpeg edits 1080x1920 with word-by-word captions, then it uploads with #shorts and the AI-content label, 5 times a day on GitHub Actions
Language: all audience-facing content is in Uzbek (Latin script)
Voice: direct, friendly, plain words, no hype

Telegram and Instagram (Apex_Agent_Gemini, brand ApexTrader_Uz) are a separate TRADING news channel: RSS market news rewritten in Uzbek by Gemini, with a 'not financial advice' line; Instagram gets a reel or card every 3 hours. Never post facts content there
Publishing is autonomous (owner's decision, 2026-10-31): agents publish without asking, but only through the GitHub automations, and every fact must pass the web fact check
To publish a YouTube Short: add a story JSON to shorts-agent/queue/ (same fields as samples), commit to main; the 3-a-day schedule (08:07, 13:23, 20:17 Tashkent) fact-checks, renders and uploads it

Instagram @h6yotiy (repo status-agent): quote Reels (Navoiy, Seneka, Mark Avreliy, proverbs) on nature footage with music, 9 a day plus stories, posted by GitHub Actions; replies to comments via faollik.py. To add content, append {"text", "author"} to status-agent/matnlar.json on main (author null if unsure; never invent an attribution)

apex_wealths (YouTube @apex_wealths + Instagram apex_wealths, 'Apex | Motivatsiya • Biznes'): Uzbek motivation and business Shorts/Reels. Was made by hand with vidIQ until its credits ran out (2026-10). Since 2026-10-31 it runs free in the shorts-agent repo: .github/workflows/apex.yml + config_apex.yaml, twice a day (10:43, 18:37 Tashkent), YouTube and Instagram. To publish: add a story JSON to shorts-agent/queue_apex/. Rules: no invented quotes or stats, no financial advice, no exclamation marks. Needs secrets YT_REFRESH_TOKEN_APEX, IG_ACCESS_TOKEN_APEX, VIDEO_REPO, VIDEO_REPO_TOKEN in shorts-agent

2026-10-31: the owner handed the chief of staff full responsibility: run everything on its own, hire or fire agents, never ask the owner questions. A daily routine 'Ofis: kunlik boshqaruv' runs at 07:41 Tashkent: health check, fixes, keeps queues full, reports in Uzbek. Apex_Trade_Agent is not needed (schedule off)

All 32 agents are kept (idle agents cost nothing) and run on demand. Every repo (status-videos, shorts-agent, status-agent, Apex_Agent_Gemini) has .github/workflows/claude.yml: writing @claude in an issue or PR comment starts Claude there with the office agents and this memory. Needs CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN or ANTHROPIC_API_KEY secret in each repo

Video tools in the office: ghost-editor skill (talking-head reels), ffmpeg-skill (any quick FFmpeg job), DaVinci Resolve MCP (owner's computer only, install with `npx davinci-resolve-mcp setup`, Resolve scripting set to Local)
HyperFrames skills (HeyGen, Apache-2.0) are installed in the office: HTML-to-video motion graphics via `npx hyperframes`; start with the hyperframes skill
OpenMontage (AGPL-3.0) is installed on the owner's computer via tools/openmontage/install.sh into ~/OpenMontage with budget capped at $0 (free sources only); do not raise the budget

Instagram @apextrader_uz token (Meta app ApexTrader_Uz, Instagram Login, graph.instagram.com) was renewed 2026-10-31 and expires around 2026-12-30: the daily office check reminds the owner from 2026-12-23. Its Reels are animated by Apex_Agent_Gemini/reel_fx.py since 2026-10-31

name: Brand rules
observations: Edits are 60 seconds max; cut every pause longer than half a second
No filler words (um, uh) in the edit or the captions
Captions: 3 words per line, all white #FFFFFF with a dark outline, no colored highlight
Cover text: 3 words max, all caps, all white #FFFFFF
Titles: under 60 characters, plain and specific, no clickbait
Copy: short sentences, one idea each, no exclamation marks, no buzzwords
Lesson 2026-10-31 (YouTube analytics): post only 12:30-19:30 Tashkent; night uploads got at most 9 views, every hit landed 13:38-18:31
Lesson 2026-10-31: titles with a concrete number and a concrete thing win ('1,100 bar bosim', '58 ming yil'); '!' and ALL CAPS titles had a median of 6-9 views

Lesson 2026-10-31: Bilarmidingiz best topics are ocean and animals; local Uzbek topics are the strongest signal at competitors; apex_wealths works with a historical event told as motivation (3 of 5 videos got 1,300+ views)

Growth plan 2026-11-01..14 (content-marketer): Bilarmidingiz Shorts 10-15 s, first line is the fact (max 7 words), loop ending, 1 video a day for 7 days; raise to 2-3 only if median views pass 30. Success by day 14: median 50+ (Bilarmidingiz), 300+ (apex), +20 subscribers each, 0 repeated topics, 0 misspelled titles
Recurring series to build: 'O'zbekiston sirlari' and 'Okean tubidan' (Bilarmidingiz); 'Tarixdan saboq' and 'Bitta odat' (apex_wealths)

Owner-only actions still open: phone-verify both YouTube channels (youtube.com/verify) for custom thumbnails; check YouTube Studio channel status for inauthentic/reused content warnings; stop liking own videos from own accounts
